description: Get one mine's record from MSHA open government data by year since 2016. The record includes operator employee hours, operator and contractor employee injuries as reported to MSHA with degree codes 01 to 06, the injury rate per 200,000 hours for a full year with 20,000 hours or more, inspections and inspection hours, violations with significant and substantial and contested counts, with vacated ones left out, proposed, current and paid penalties, controller and operator history with dates, and the source file of every figure.

mine_id.description: MSHA mine ID, up to seven digits.

name: get_mine
title: Get a mine's record
